description.en: Type of diagnosis, indicating which diagnostic rules are hit.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。

默认值：

- 当不设置值或设置的值小于20时，默认值为20。

- 当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100。
description.en:
Number of items per page in a paginated query. The maximum value is 100.

Default value:

- If no value is set or the set value is less than 20, the default value is 20.
- If the set value is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的 NextToken 参数值。
description.en: NextToken for the next page. Include this value when requesting the next page.

descriptions.en: An interface for creating a session, which returns the frontend EndPoint and initiates a periodic task to track the session status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller list-diagnostic-results --next-token a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f52461200000 --max-results 20 --diag-type NetDiag --resource-group-id rg-acfmywpvugk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
